The '''Tion Trade Route''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that snaked along the [[Indrexu Spiral]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It winded irregularly along the Spiral, starting from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian]] sector capital of [[Estaria/Legends|Estaria]], passing through the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], and ending near the southern border of [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath sector]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
